options.content: **DSPOT** turns each detector's scores into alarms with false-alarm probability `q`. Threshold = the alarm line at alarm time; it moves with drift. Warm-up: the first 500 scores per (agent, detector) raise no alarms.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '1m'), agent_id || ' / ' || detector AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM alarms WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Alarm threshold over time (by agent / detector)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT occurred_at AS time, agent_id || ' / ' || detector AS metric, threshold AS value
FROM alarms WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Alarm rate vs q (per agent / detector, selected time range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.agent_id || ' / ' || s.detector AS stream, count(*) AS scores, count(a.event_id) AS alarms,
       round(100.0 * count(a.event_id) / count(*), 3) AS "alarm %", max(a.q) * 100 AS "q %"
FROM scores s LEFT JOIN alarms a ON a.scored_event_id = s.scored_event_id AND a.detector = s.detector
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
